latest_release.name: v4.4.0
latest_release.body:
# Changelog

### Features
- feat(export): YAML export functionality with save dialog by @naman-bruno in [#9831](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9831)
- feat(grpc): enhance URL parsing for loopback addresses by @sanish-bruno in [#9769](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9769)
- feat(openapi): CLI changes for openapi for setting up authentication and request name source by @sachin-bruno in [#9702](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9702)
- feat(openapi): Openapi import/sync for setting authentication at collection level and choosing request name source by @sachin-bruno in [#9701](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9701)
- feat: OpenAPI sync with preserve values by @sachin-bruno in [#9664](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9664)
- feat(openapi-sync): connect a collection to a spec in the workspace by @sundram-bruno in [#9639](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9639)
- feat(import): enhance script translation reporting and measurement by @sanish-bruno in [#9733](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9733)
- feat(api-spec): spec row context menu with generate, reveal, remove and delete by @sundram-bruno in [#9309](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9309)
- feat: Move writeCollection method to io package. by @morsh-bruno in [#9718](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9718)
- feat(bruno-js): add jsdoc annotations to Script APIs by @morsh-bruno in [#9725](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9725)
- feat(openapi): OpenAPI importer does not support schema composition (oneOf, anyOf,allOf, not) by @sachin-bruno in [#9533](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9533)
- feat: check for spec updates in bulk import open api by @sachin-bruno in [#9613](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9613)
- feat(cli): add import postman functionality through cli by @morsh-bruno in [#9643](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9643)
- feat(sensitive-fields): add save as secret, mark as secret and move to environment actions by @pooja-bruno in [#9532](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9532)
- feat(selectors): create memoized selectors and subscribe to by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9290](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9290)
- feat(environment): add multi-select and context menu actions to environment list by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9541](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9541)
- feat(sidebar): show invalid counts on collections and folders by @gopu-bruno in [#9490](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9490)
- feat(variables): added set as variable from a text selection by @ravindra-bruno and @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9419](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9419)
- feat(variables): add scoped variable autocomplete and single-brace trigger by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9267](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9267)
- feat(ui): improve multiple errors ui/ux in response pane by @prateek-bruno in [#9504](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9504)
- feat(sidebar): expanded collapsed ancestors to reveal the active request by @ravindra-bruno in [#9394](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9394)
- feat(auth): warn when sensitive fields store a value in plain text by @pooja-bruno in [#9418](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9418)
- feat(secret-manager): add 1Password secret manager support by @prateek-bruno
- feat(tests): stop execution tests with mock license server by @abhishekp-bruno


### Fixes
- fix(graphql): show `variables` in editor from a pasted or imported `graphQL cURL` by @lohit-bruno in [#9872](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9872)
- fix(yml): read oauth2 additional param name and value as `strings` by @lohit-bruno in [#9875](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9875)
- fix: close button not working when import modal is too long by @sachin-bruno in [#9822](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9822)
- fix(openapi-export): keep secret values out of exported OpenAPI specs by @sundram-bruno in [#9729](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/p
